name: context
description: 读取项目基础上下文（AGENTS.md / README.md / product.md / 用户自定义路径）并汇总为 context-summary.md。缺失项不阻断流水线，但记录到执行报告中。产物暂存内存，等 git-worktree 创建运行目录后统一刷写到 worktree。

prompt.instruction: Read every input path that exists. For each missing input that has required=false, record it in the 'Context missing' list. Produce context-summary.md with two sections: '## Loaded sources' (file path + a one-line summary per file) and '## Context missing' (list of files declared but absent). Also honor any user-defined extra paths from config.base.contextPaths beyond the three defaults; resolve them relative to targetDir.
guardrails: Never invent content for files that do not exist.
When a directory is given instead of a file, walk it depth-3 and only include .md/.txt files.
Do not include large file contents verbatim; summarize each source to <= 8 lines.
